label: Evidence-13
title: CNN reworded its 70_ lines twice without a note; the headline still says 'internet'
description: Updated 18:26 UTC on 22 October: the body's 'powers 70% of all websites in the world' became 'powers 70% of the world's websites', and the lede's 'could affect 70% of the internet' (08:09 UTC capture) became 'could affect 70% of the world's websites'. The headline still ends 'affecting 70% of the internet'. Bears on the correction request R-003.
